recap.text: Grimaldi is a level 85 City Boss and dwarf who became the Pestiferous Vine during a nine-tier poison cloud attack. He controls mold-covered parasites that infect lemurs and clowns, bringing them back to life each day. Grimaldi speaks to Carl through parasites in Carl's gut to tell Signet he has un-banished her. Signet walks into the tent.

Grimaldi's circus took in a half-Naiad child that no throne would keep and put her on a poster as Tsarina Signet and Her Amazing Battle Squad. The child grew up and fell in love with him. When he came to this world, they planted him next to an all-tree node, and the roots intertwined. Crawler Carl does not ask if the ringmaster is alive.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: Grimaldi's Traveling Circus is pitched in one of the Over City's districts. Grimaldi, proprietor. Tonight two crawlers, Carl and Princess Donut, are scouting the grounds as the mobs form up for the night. That is the whole entry so far: a tent, a company, and two people looking at it from the dark. Filed under Over City, third floor.
beats.gist: Carl and Princess Donut scout Grimaldi's Traveling Circus in an Over City district.

beats.headline: He became the vine
beats.text: Signet's account, given on the walk. The poison cloud was a nine-tier attack; the lucky ones died and the rest transformed. Grimaldi, owner and ringleader, stood in the centre ring at the end of a show and became the vine. Everyone in the tent was then infected with mold-covered parasites that put them under his control: lemurs, clowns, almost everyone. When they die, the spores return to the vine, and they are reborn the next day. He took her in as a child. She loves him. She attacks every night.
beats.gist: Grimaldi became a vine and controls mold-covered parasites after a nine-tier poison cloud attack.

beats.headline: Ringmaster, and City Boss
beats.text: Ringmaster Grimaldi, Pestiferous Vine. Elite. Level 85 City Boss. A dwarf, once, standing centre stage when the cloud swept over the circus, and there to this day. However often his family dies and however many crawlers the clowns devour, he brings them back, memories mostly intact. His sign at the entrance promises that within the tent all worries and fears are left behind. Inside, the performers keep performing. A crawler has just sat down on the bleachers beside him.
beats.gist: Grimaldi is a level 85 dwarf City Boss and ringmaster who brings back dead family.

beats.headline: Speaking through a crawler
beats.text: Through the parasites in Carl's gut, Grimaldi reaches him: Carl. No. Come back. Please. The Wisp Armor keeps the crawler's legs his own, and he carries the voice out of the tent to Signet at the calliope. Carl makes the case for both of them. Once the worms force words out of his throat — "She hurts the family. She has turned her back." The last words they force out are Grimaldi's answer to her: "I have un-banished you, my love." Signet walks into the tent. Carl's part of the quest is complete.
beats.gist: Grimaldi speaks through parasites in Carl's gut to tell Signet she is un-banished.

beats.headline: The stray the circus kept
beats.text: Background, for the file. Grimaldi's circus took in a half-Naiad child that no throne would keep, and put her on a poster: Tsarina Signet and Her Amazing Battle Squad. The child grew up. The child fell in love with him. Ringmasters take in strays. It is most of the job.
beats.gist: Grimaldi took in a half-Naiad child and put her on a poster.

beats.headline: Planted by an all-tree
beats.text: Status update on Redstone Grimaldi, filed by Tsarina Signet from a log outside the town. When he came to this world, they planted him next to an all-tree node. The roots intertwined, and he became one with the tree. The tree's roots go deep; it has survived countless infestations like this, she says, and will outlast this one. Crawler Carl did not ask whether that means the ringmaster is alive. He decided not to pursue it.
beats.gist: Tsarina Signet files a log stating Redstone Grimaldi became one with an all-tree node.
